[[File:David anime.png|thumb|250px|David (left)]] '''David''' (Japanese: '''デイビッド''' ''David'') is a minor character who appeared in ''[[M03|Spell of the Unown: Entei]]''. He works as a butler, alongside three other maids, at [[Spencer Hale]]'s manor. After Hale disappeared while examining some faraway ruins, David was informed of this by Hale's assistant [[Schuyler]]. They were discussing the events when Hale's daughter [[Molly Hale|Molly]] came into the room, and David volunteered to give her the news. Later, when Molly first unleashed the {{OBP|Unown|M03}}, he was forced to flee to the local [[Pokémon Center]] as the mansion (and later much of [[Greenfield]]) became crystallized. After {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} intervened, Molly abandoned her fantasy world, which returned Greenfield back to normal. As a result, David was among those who returned to the Hale household.
